thresholds: Strict >50; peak thresholds and still-above-50 confirmation thresholds are separate predefined variants
turns: DI−[2] < DI−[1] > DI−[0]; abs spread[2] < spread[1] > spread[0]; DI+[2] > DI+[1] < DI+[0]
interpretation_sensitivity: The literal DI+ did not decrease version only requires DI+[0] >= DI+[1], without a prior DI+ decline. The strict three-candle trough remains the primary rule.
trend: Same-timeframe confirmed Trend.direction BEARISH at the signal close; missing Trend excluded and counted
entry: Next contiguous 15m open; no RSI condition; one position per coin
exit: 0.5% net hard-stop budget from entry. Current last-closed bearish Regime: fixed +1% net target. Bullish: profit >=1% AND DI+ >50 arms a permanent 0.5% highest-since-entry trail. Neutral/unknown entry Regime excluded and counted; while holding, unknown Regime cannot arm a new exit.
execution: Stored continuous 1m, otherwise 5m, otherwise labeled 15m source. Both low-first/high-first OHLC paths; no fixed holding timeout; actual adverse opens retained. Unresolved positions occupy capital.
reference: No pivot labels select entries. Frozen complete reconstructed context and partial current memory are reported separately; no new classifiers run.
